description:
See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version.

See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.

Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools, has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.

- Study anything: websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files. Real inspection tools find out how they are built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.
- Build your own: say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.
- Checked, not guessed: every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it is close.
- Agent-ready: hundreds of tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.
